expectedRealization.rationale: A reopening inflection may propagate through industrial earnings over one to two quarters, but broad PMI rebound is insufficient on its own.

changeHypothesis.summary: March PMI rebounded from shutdown lows, but Jan-Feb industrial profits remained deeply negative and NBS explicitly cautioned that activity was not normalized.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Domestic reopening can continue, but global demand and low-base effects make the aggregate signal noisy.
disconfirmingEvidence: No narrow company earnings bridge was frozen by March 31.

causalChain.mechanism: Factories resume production after February shutdown.
causalChain.failureMode: global demand collapse offsets domestic reopening

causalChain.mechanism: Only if orders/margins recover does PMI translate into profit.
causalChain.failureMode: low-base PMI rebound without earnings recovery
